lines.text: Midnight 12.1.5 now has a date: the Kith'ix raid, Labyrinth of Kindo'jan and Aqir Invasions arrive Oct 13, with Orin's extra weekly Voidcore quest to finish beforehand

Pokemon GO added Minior's Orionids debut Oct 19-24, the Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf Max Battle Day Oct 24 ($4.99), the Night Out Twitch drop Oct 24, and Halloween Part I Oct 27 - Nov 1 with its own GO Pass
WoW: Forever's Nov 4 launch is now inside the window, and Pokopia's Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises runs Oct 17 - Nov 1
City Safari: Boston is rescheduled as global gameplay for ticket holders Oct 24-25, with refunds only until Oct 20

needs_you.action: Redeem the Chansey Plant code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7
Claim any unclaimed GO Pass: September rewards before they expire Oct 8 at 10am local
Use your remaining Aniimo Discovery search attempts before the event closes Oct 9 at 3:59am server time
Evolve Zorua by 9pm local on Community Day for Zoroark's exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch; the $1.99 Special Research is only worth buying before the 2-5pm event
Complete and claim the free World Space Week Timed Research (Astronaut Pikachu) by Oct 12 at 11:59pm local
Turn in Orin Straylight's "In the Catalyst's Shadow" and "Prismatic Potential" before Oct 13 maintenance so the extra weekly Nebulous Voidcore unlocks with 12.1.5
Hatch with the GO Pass Deluxe: September Timed Incubator before it expires Oct 13 at 10am local
Finish both Sandile Hatch Day Timed Researches, free and the $1.99 paid track, by 5pm local the same day, or their rewards are lost
Rank up GO Pass: Fall Marathon and claim the free Pikachu visor Timed Research before Oct 19 at 8pm local; unlocked pass rewards expire Oct 21 at 8pm
Watch for Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes emailing from Oct 20 and pass them on; guests can only redeem them for launch week Nov 4-11

Visit a participating Best Buy, GameStop or Target to pick up the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research by Oct 20 at 10pm local (claim by Nov 20); redeem a store-bought GO gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap
City Safari: Boston ticket holders who do not want the rescheduled global gameplay Oct 24-25 must request a refund through in-app support by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST
Buy the $4.99 Max Battle Day ticket before sales close Oct 24 at 5pm local, then watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream from 7:30pm PDT for the Night Out jersey code
Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27 (through Nov 3) for upgrade buyers; two-part names are region unique and go first come, first served
Spend Windborn Stamps in the Limited Time Shop before Part I ends Oct 28 at 11:59pm server time, when leftovers convert to Credits; Journey Chronicles login gifts close Oct 29 at 3:59am
Finish the October Traveler's Log for the Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1
Trade pumpkin candy for Pumpkaboo's event furniture at the Pokemon Center before Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises ends Nov 1 at 4:59am local
Rank up GO Pass: October before rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points Oct 31 - Nov 1; rewards expire Nov 5, and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket must be used by Nov 8
Rank up GO Pass: Halloween 2026 before it ends Nov 5 at 8pm local; unlocked rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts holiday and patch dates about 1-2 weeks ahead; Wowhead's calendar runs further out

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the Venomous Abyss raid and a Mythic+ pool that gets a mid-season refresh and Keystone Myth on Oct 13.

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The Unbinding of Kith'ix single-boss raid, the nine-chamber Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, Aqir Invasions in Eversong and Zul'Aman, Keystone Myth and a new campaign arrive with weekly maintenance Oct 13.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Costumed Calamity in October
timeline.detail: October's stock has the Bilebound Ur'zul mount, the Headless Horseman's Hallowed Charger and the Archmage's Familiar cat; fill the Traveler's Log for Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire before the Oct 31 rotation.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (October)
timeline.detail: Ride the carousel for the XP buff and turn in profession quests before the Faire packs up Oct 10.

timeline.title: Mists of Pandaria Timewalking
timeline.detail: Run five Timewalking dungeons for the weekly quest's Heroic raid cache and spend Timewarped Badges at the Pandaria vendors.

timeline.title: The Great Gnomeregan Run (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Make a level-one Gnome and run from Gnomeregan to Booty Bay with the crowd for the weekend-only buffs and title.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Fight the Headless Horseman daily for his mount and farm Tricky Treats for the holiday vendors; Blizzard has not posted dates yet.
timeline.estimate_basis: Wowhead lists Oct 19 - Nov 2; Darmory's US calendar lists Oct 18 - Nov 1

timeline.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking
timeline.detail: Queue Draenor Timewalking for the weekly cache and the Garrison-era vendor transmog.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (November)
timeline.detail: The Faire returns for its November week with the Trading Post rotation.

timeline.title: Day of the Dead
timeline.detail: Visit a graveyard outside a capital city to dance with Catrina for the Macabre Marionette pet and holiday cooking.

timeline.title: Midnight Dungeon Event
timeline.detail: Complete four Mythic Midnight dungeons for the weekly bonus-event reward.

timeline.title: Abyssal Crown Collection
timeline.detail: Azshara's raiment and the void-touched Zothwing mount are still the featured bundle on the Battle.net shop.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Oct 6 (now): Mists of Pandaria Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard; Darkmoon Faire through Oct 10; Gnomeregan Run Oct 10-12; finish Orin Straylight's "In the Catalyst's Shadow" and "Prismatic Potential" quests before reset for the extra weekly Nebulous Voidcore
Week of Oct 13: 12.1.5 goes live with maintenance; Battleground and Pet Battle Bonus Events; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Hallow's End begins Oct 19 per Wowhead (Oct 18 per Darmory)
Week of Oct 20: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk (Darmory also lists Comp Stomp); the crest cap lifts and Orin's Ascendant Venomstones unlock after maintenance
Week of Oct 27: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1; Day of the Dead Nov 1-3; Hallow's End ends Nov 2
Week of Nov 3: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble; Darkmoon Faire through Nov 7; WoW: Forever launches Nov 4
Nov 10 (window end): Arena Skirmish Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible begin at reset
just_past_window: Nov 10-17: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Moonkin Festival Nov 12-13
Nov 17: WoW's 22nd Anniversary begins (through Dec 8), alongside a Timewalking week and PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu
Nov 22-29: Pilgrim's Bounty; World Quest Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Southshore vs. Tarren Mill from Nov 24

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts Forever dates on the WoW news site, usually 1-2 weeks ahead

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta
timeline.detail: Level cap is 30 since the Oct 1 build; Epic Pack and Collection buyers are flagged in, opt-in invites continue, and Oct 21 is the last full day of testing (the open Server Slam window is still unannounced).

timeline.title: PAX Aus keynote: new Forever dungeon deep dive
timeline.detail: Holly Longdale and Clay Stone stream the Storytime keynote with a behind-the-scenes look at a new Forever dungeon on the Warcraft Twitch channel, Oct 8 from 6:00 to 7:30 p.m. PDT.

timeline.title: Escape Together: Scarlet Monastery escape room
timeline.detail: Book the Scarlet Monastery escape room at Escape Manor in Toronto Oct 8-11, or watch the Horde vs. Alliance showdown on Warcraft Twitch and YouTube Oct 23 (stream time still to be announced).

timeline.title: Pre-purchase upgrades: Heroic $29.99, Epic $59.99, Collection $79.99
timeline.detail: The Skyborne Heroic Pack unlocks the Skyborne race and name reservation, the Epic Pack adds beta access and 30 days of Game Time, and the Warcraft Forever Collection adds Warcraft III: Reforged with Forsaken Kingdom and is sold only through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Collector's Edition restock
timeline.detail: The restocked physical Collector's Edition (statue, mousepad, pins, journal and the Collection digital code) is limited to one per household and ships February 2027, after launch.

timeline.title: Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes start emailing
timeline.detail: Codes email to Heroic (one) and Epic or Collection (three) buyers from Oct 20; forward them so friends can play launch week Nov 4-11 without a subscription.

timeline.title: Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Any upgrade buyer can create and customize up to three characters and lock two-part names, first come first served, before launch.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever launches
timeline.detail: Forever opens globally at 3:00 p.m. PST with 4 new zones, 9 new dungeons and the Skyborne race, included with any WoW subscription or Game Time; Epic Pack and Collection buyers get 30 days of Game Time added that day.

weekly_rhythm: Beta cadence: realm restarts, Known Issues and Development Notes posts land most weekdays on the Forever forums (see the Wowhead Blue Tracker)
Rulesets at launch are Normal, PvP and Roleplaying; Hardcore joins sometime after launch
Per Wowhead's roadmap: the first three raids (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair) open Dec 9, Hardcore in winter 2026
just_past_window: Nov 11: Invite-A-Friend launch-week access ends; guests need a subscription or Game Time from here

games.typical_lead_time: Niantic posts event details 1-3 weeks ahead; the month's schedule drops near the end of the prior month

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Seasonal spawns, Paldean debuts, Mega Staraptor and Chandelure, and GO Battle League Mega Editions run through Dec 1 at 10am local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: October
timeline.detail: Free track pays out a Kyogre encounter; Deluxe ($7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) adds a Lucky Trinket and Super Incubator; GO Points are uncapped Oct 31 - Nov 1, rewards expire Nov 5 at 10am local.

timeline.title: adidas | Pokemon Timed Research
timeline.detail: Finish the free Timed Research for the adidas avatar items before it expires Jan 15 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration
timeline.detail: Open the game inside a Best Buy, GameStop or Target to grab the Timed Research (claim by Nov 20) and fight Mega Gengar in store raids; redeem a store-bought gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap.

timeline.title: World Space Week
timeline.detail: Astronaut Pikachu debuts in one-star raids and the free Timed Research, which must be claimed by Oct 12 at 11:59pm local.

timeline.title: Zorua Community Day
timeline.detail: Catch Zorua with 3x XP and 2x Candy, then evolve by 9pm local for Zoroark's exclusive Sucker Punch; the $1.99 Special Research is optional.

timeline.title: Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek
timeline.detail: Bramblin debuts from Incense and GO Pass tasks, Mega Manectric can reach Super Max level, and the event GO Pass Deluxe is $4.99 ($6.99 with 6 ranks); rewards expire Oct 21 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Sandile Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Sandile hatches from 2 km Eggs at half distance with 2x hatch Candy; the free Timed Research and the $1.99 track (1/4 hatch distance, two Super Incubators) both expire at 5pm local.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Orionids
timeline.detail: Minior debuts in the wild from Oct 19 at 5pm through Oct 24 at 11:59pm local, with shooting-star skies and boosted spawns 5-9pm nightly.

timeline.title: Dynamax Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Dynamax Azelf debuts in the Americas with 8x Max Particles from Power Spots; the $4.99 ticket (Max Mushroom, 6,400 MP) is only sold until 5pm local, and the remote raid cap doubles Oct 23-24.

timeline.title: City Safari: Boston (rescheduled, ticket holders only)
timeline.detail: The washed-out Boston event now runs as global gameplay for current ticket holders, with Timed Research for Flabebe, Hawlucha, Mudbray and Komala; refunds must be requested by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST.

timeline.title: Pokemon Night Out Twitch drop
timeline.detail: Watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream with a linked Trainer Central account for a Timed Research code that unlocks the Night Out baseball jersey.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Costumed Pikachu, Zubat and Sinistea debut with trick-or-treat surprises; the Halloween GO Pass runs through Nov 5 (Deluxe $7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) and its rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day (October)
timeline.detail: A three-hour Super Mega Raid Day is on the calendar for Halloween afternoon; the featured Mega has not been announced.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
timeline.detail: Part II runs Nov 1 at 10am through Nov 5 at 8pm local, closing out the Halloween GO Pass; details are not posted yet.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Spotlight Hours: Elgyem Oct 8 (2x catch Candy); Stufful Oct 15 (2x transfer Candy); Morelull Oct 22 (2x catch Stardust); Gastly Oct 29 (2x evolve XP); November not yet posted
Max Mondays: Rookidee Oct 12; Sneasel Oct 19; Sableye Oct 26
5-star raids: Yveltal Oct 7-13; Dialga Oct 14-20; Palkia Oct 21-27; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28 - Nov 3; Nov 4-10 not yet announced
Raid Hours: Yveltal Oct 7; Dialga Oct 14; Palkia Oct 21; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28
Mega Raids: Blastoise Oct 7-13; Dragonite Oct 14-20; Charizard X and Y Oct 21-27; Sableye Oct 28 - Nov 3; Shadow Landorus in weekend Shadow Raids Oct 7 - Nov 3

GO Battle League (rotates Tuesdays 1pm PDT): Mega Editions of all three leagues Oct 6-13; Great, Ultra Mega and Little Cup Oct 13-20; Ultra, Master Mega and Fantasy Cup Oct 20-27; Master and Mega Halloween Cup Oct 27 - Nov 3; Mega Editions again Nov 3-10; GO Battle Thursdays give 4x Stardust and 10 sets
In-person: Wild Area 2026 in Sendai and Mexico City Nov 6-8 (ticketed, on site, no US stop); Season 24's last Community Day is Nov 21
just_past_window: Nov 10-17: GO Battle League Great League, Ultra League: Mega Edition and the 2026 GO LAIC Cup
Nov 14-15: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026: Global; Minior Showers: Leonids Nov 14-19
Nov 21: November Community Day (featured Pokemon not announced)

games.typical_lead_time: The Pokemon Company announces Pokopia events about 2-3 weeks ahead on pokemon.com

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Redeem code P0K0P1AGARDENS at a Pokemon Center PC before it stops working Oct 7.

timeline.title: Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises
timeline.detail: Learn Camouflage from Zorua, prank Pokemon for pumpkin candy and trade it at the Pokemon Center for spooky furniture before Nov 1 at 4:59am local; Pumpkaboo and Gourgeist stay afterward.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the launch Ditto Rug via Mystery Gift over the internet before Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now, Part 2 late 2026
timeline.detail: The $34.99 pass includes Bubbly Basin now, accessories and new Pokemon in Part 2 late this year, and a third town in 2027; buying by Aug 31, 2027 emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots.

just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 is still only dated "late 2026": accessories, new furniture and Pokemon, no new town

games.typical_lead_time: Pawprint posts update notices on aniimo.com about 2 days before maintenance

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis
timeline.detail: Collect weekly Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod for Irisalis, then the Blessing Gifts pod for a guaranteed Perfect-potential Sparkling capture, before Dec 9 at 7:59pm server time.

timeline.title: Aniimo Discovery
timeline.detail: Spend the Institute's free Search Attempts (they do not stack) to track and capture the new Aniimo before Oct 9 at 3:59am server time.

timeline.title: Vein Abundance: Berylline Vale
timeline.detail: Prismana Form Waleetle spawns in Berylline Vale through Oct 12 at 3:59am server time.

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Log in on enough days to claim every travel gift before the event closes Oct 29 at 3:59am server time.

timeline.title: Season 1 Part II and a new region
timeline.detail: The in-game Season Overview promises a brand-new region with Part II; unspent Windborn Stamps convert to Credits when Part I ends Oct 28.
timeline.estimate_basis: In-game Season Overview as reported by AniimoTools; no official notice yet

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: Log in with the email you used for the beta tests, or link it in Account Center before creating a character, or the test rewards cannot be claimed.

weekly_rhythm: Holo-Battle Interlink runs weekly from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 server time, with Star Rank and Support rewards resetting each cycle
Egg Heist Chaos Mode is open for Tier IV Elite Egg Seekers and costs a Chaos Ticket per run
Shop features the Radiant Waveglow appearance set (980 Lumin Crystals) and the Laurel Moon Blessing pack (280)
Per the in-game calendar (unofficial): Glamour Star rounds Oct 9-15 and Oct 23-29, Eggceleration weekends Oct 9-11, 16-18 and 23-25, Vein Abundance in Nimbus Fields Oct 12-18
